_meta.purpose: Seed data for future mapping into the app's SearchQuery object (lib/types.ts). Not wired into lib/mock/data.ts or any app code. Research-only, per issue #4.
_meta.IMPORTANT_deviation_from_lib_types_ts: lib/types.ts's SearchQuery has a numeric volumeMonthly field. No keyword-volume tool (Google Keyword Planner, Ahrefs, etc.) was available in this research pass, and the issue explicitly says 'do not fabricate volumes.' Every record below therefore sets volumeMonthly to null and adds a qualitative relativeInterestTier (low/medium/high) plus a rationale, sourced only from how many independent competitors target the phrase and how organically it appears in non-marketing sources (forums). This is deliberately NOT a substitute for real keyword data -- see README.md open gap #7. Do not treat relativeInterestTier as a proxy for real search volume in any downstream scoring without a human explicitly signing off on that mapping.
_meta.searchSurfaceIdNote: No SearchSurface records exist yet (see README.md Human Gate section) -- searchSurfaceId is intentionally null throughout.
